name: Deep Learning 3 — Practice Lab (Gradient Method, Neurons, Spiral Classification)
description: Guided learner workspace for the third lab of a beginner Deep Learning course (2×45 min), corrected 1.1 edition. The learner builds, configures and interprets the network; the data preparation and the evaluation figures are ready-made. Programs: environment check; the gradient method on one weight and one bias with synthetic data (G03_01); spiral classification with a hidden-layer-free baseline model (G03_02); a 16-neuron network and then two 50-neuron layers with a mandatory learning-rate experiment 0.01 → 0.001, everything else unchanged (G03_03); final evaluation of the saved, chosen model on the held-out test set (G03_04). Four runs are compared, the model is chosen and justified by the learner from the validation loss, and the lab closes with 10 multiple-choice code-comprehension questions. Run with the Run button or from the terminal; everything runs locally, no Colab, no GPU needed, no homework.
